description: Plant-based protein and superfood brand selling vegan protein powders, collagen-building proteins, superfood greens and supplements, with a long-running affiliate program and a creator content program.

evidence.summary: Sunwarrior's own affiliate panel on Affiliatly states verbatim: 'the earnings are uncapped' and 'You can make as much as you want - it is in your hands.' The panel sets a $100 payout threshold, pays on the 2nd Thursday of each month, and publishes affiliates@sunwarrior.com for contact. The cap is verified uncapped on the brand's own affiliate portal.

Third-party listings conflict on Sunwarrior's creator commission rate: the Impact listing is reported at 5%, a Shopper listing at 6%, and the brand's separate salon partnership page offers stylists 10% plus a 10% client discount. No single creator rate settles across fetched sources, so commission_rate is recorded as null rather than guessed.
The brand's affiliate panel publishes affiliates@sunwarrior.com as the affiliate contact and describes dashboard tracking of visitors, leads and sales.

name: Sunwarrior

reasons.compensation: Earnings are verified uncapped, but the creator commission rate conflicts across sources (5% Impact listing, 6% Shopper, 10% salon partnership), so the rate is null and the score is held down.
reasons.contact_access: A dedicated affiliates@sunwarrior.com contact is published on the brand's own affiliate panel.
reasons.credibility: An established plant-based nutrition brand founded in 2008 with wide retail and online distribution.
reasons.niche_fit: Plant-based protein and superfoods are a core UGC category for fitness and wellness creators.
reasons.opportunity_availability: The affiliate panel is open for sign-up with published payout terms.
reasons.ugc_evidence: A public affiliate panel plus a separate creator content program on the brand's site; no creator counts were published on fetched pages.

description: Direct-to-consumer supplement brand selling third-party tested, US-made wellness supplements through a tiered brand-direct partner program built for creators on TikTok, Instagram and YouTube.

evidence.summary: Peremis's official partners page states verbatim: 'Earn 20% to 35% on every sale you drive. No caps. No fees.' Tiers run Bronze 20% (everyone starts here), Silver 25% at 200 sales/month, Gold 30% at 500 and Ambassador 35% at 1,000, plus monthly bonuses and a 2-5% partner-referral share for 12 months. Commissions clear after 30 days and pay out over $50 via PayPal or store credit. The page explicitly notes TikTok Shop checkouts cannot be credited, so the program is brand-direct. The cap is verified uncapped on the brand's own page.

The same page says there is no minimum audience and no application fee, supplies partners with content kits and creative assets, and describes products as third-party tested and made in the USA in cGMP facilities.

name: Peremis

reasons.compensation: 20% starting commission rising to 35% by tier, with an explicit 'No caps' statement on the brand's own page.
reasons.contact_access: No partner email is published; contact runs through the partner dashboard and application form only.
reasons.credibility: A young, small brand with a thin public footprint; third-party testing and cGMP claims are stated on its own page only.
reasons.niche_fit: Supplements pitched directly at short-form wellness creators on TikTok, Instagram and YouTube.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Open enrollment with no minimum audience and no application fee.
reasons.ugc_evidence: The partners page is written for content creators and supplies content kits and creative assets; no creator counts were published.
